symbols.name: LiteDbCacheStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Stores Application Caching metadata, publication authority, quotas, operations and immutable payload chunks in one owned native database.
symbols.remarks: Coordination is confined to this process. Native calls execute synchronously on the named database's worker.

syntax.content: public sealed class LiteDbCacheStoreProvider : ICacheStoreProvider
